name: photo-of-the-month
description: Monatliche Foto-Challenge – Vue 3 + TypeScript Frontend, Node.js/Express REST-API

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix backend && npm audit --prefix frontend
